purpose: Research corpus for abstract trait extraction. It is not a procedural personality library.
hard_rule: Canonical character labels and combinations must not be emitted as NPC personality templates. Production generation consumes only normalized abstract traits/recipes.
methodology: Extract observable behavior rather than fandom personality typing.
Prefer official StarTrek.com descriptions/interviews and on-screen behavioral summaries.
Separate individual traits from species/cultural expression.
Record evolution as phase change where useful.
Use contradictions as data: a person can be warm and intimidating, anxious and brave, humorous and highly professional.
Do not infer severe pathology or diagnosis from dramatic behavior.
